_comment: GENERATED by Build/Scripts/build-astryx-themes.mjs. The single source of truth for which themes exist.

themes.name: Neutral
themes.character: Pure greyscale with a near-black accent, so nothing on the page competes with the content.
themes.use: Documentation, dashboards and sites where the interface should stay in the background.
themes.upstreamDescription: Quiet, warm greys that keep the focus on the content.

themes.name: Butter
themes.character: Cream paper with one bright blue accent.
themes.use: Marketing pages and product launches with one strong colour.
themes.upstreamDescription: Creamy yellows with a friendly blue accent, playful for consumer products and still easy to read.

themes.name: Chocolate
themes.character: Warm browns, with serif headings over a sans-serif body.
themes.use: Editorial sites, long reads and pages with a printed feel.
themes.upstreamDescription: Rich browns with Fraunces headings, an Albert Sans body and Lucide icons.

themes.name: Matcha
themes.character: Deep green on paper, with headings in a handwriting font and soft, rounded corners.
themes.use: Craft, food and wellbeing sites that should feel handmade.
themes.upstreamDescription: Calm, earthy greens with a natural feel, for wellness and content-first apps.

themes.name: Stone
themes.character: Cool grey with Montserrat headings over a Figtree body, quiet and formal.
themes.use: Corporate and professional-services sites that want a restrained look.
themes.upstreamDescription: Understated stone and slate colours with a slightly handmade feel.

themes.name: Gothic
themes.character: Near-white text on near-black, and the only theme that stays dark in light mode too.
themes.use: Developer tools, music and products used mostly at night.
themes.upstreamDescription: Deep blue-greys and a display serif, dramatic and editorial.

themes.name: Y2K
themes.character: Lavender background and square corners with no rounding at all.
themes.use: Playful brands with a retro look and hard edges.
themes.upstreamDescription: Hot pink, lime green and the Poppins font, playful and clearly retro.

themes.name: Harbour
themes.character: Deep navy on a cool grey page, for sites that need to look institutional.
themes.use: Public institutions, finance and law firms.

themes.name: Ember
themes.character: Warm charcoal with one ember-orange accent, kept for the most important thing on the page.
themes.use: Campaign pages with one clear call to action.

themes.name: Linen
themes.character: A soft, warm neutral for long reads, with low contrast between page and surfaces so nothing competes with the text.

themes.name: Orchid
themes.character: Muted purple on a cool page. Distinctive but calm, and more decorative than corporate.

themes.name: Cobalt
themes.character: A strong blue on near-white, for dashboards and documentation where the accent appears many times on a page.

themes.name: Moss
themes.character: Deep forest green, cooler and quieter than Matcha, for organisations that want green without a wellness look.

themes.name: Clay
themes.character: Terracotta and warm stone, with the roundest corners of all the themes.

themes.name: Plum
themes.character: Deep aubergine on a slightly warm page, suited to a publication rather than a product.

themes.name: Sand
themes.character: Dark umber text on pale ochre paper: bright but not white, for sites read outdoors or on low-cost screens.
themes.use: Sites read outdoors or on low-cost screens.

themes.name: Ink
themes.character: Near-black on white, for sites that need the highest possible contrast.
themes.use: Sites that need the highest contrast.

themes.name: Lagoon
themes.character: Blue-green on a pale page, fresher than Cobalt and warmer than Harbour, but not turquoise.

themes.name: Rose
themes.character: Muted dusty rose that looks calm rather than sweet, with serif headings over a plain body.

themes.name: Graphite
themes.character: Cool monochrome with no hue in the brand colours, for sites where the images supply all the colour.

themes.name: Frost
themes.character: Calm arctic blue-grey, adapted from the Nord palette (MIT) and easy to read in bright office light.

themes.name: Latte
themes.character: Soft mauve on a cool white page, adapted from Catppuccin Latte (MIT), for products that want to feel friendly.

themes.name: Solar
themes.character: Cream paper and dark cyan, adapted from Ethan Schoonover's Solarized (MIT), with deliberately low contrast for long reading sessions.

themes.name: Retro
themes.character: Warm amber on yellowed cream, adapted from Gruvbox (MIT), with the look of a printed manual.

themes.name: Midnight
themes.character: Indigo on a pale blue-grey page, adapted from Tokyo Night (MIT). It was designed dark first, so its dark mode looks deliberate.
